claims.verbatim:
Ship Christel (Brem.), Friedrichs, Rotterdam, July 15, with mdse.
and 36 pass. to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. Aug. 8, lat. 42 14, long. 39
59, spoke whaling bark Buster, of and from New-Bedford, 3 months
out, with 51 bbls. sp. oil; 9th, lat. 43 56, long. 44 29, saw ship Web-
ster, hence for Liverpool; 16th, lat. 42[?] 50, long. 61 04, saw bark A. J.
York, and Br. bark Mary Lord, bound E.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 July 1866, p. 3, col. 4
Lloyd's List, 6 September 1866, p. 4, col. 5 (British Newspaper Archive)
The Sun (New York), 25 August 1866, p. 4, col. 3
